frames.label: 충돌 접근
frames.pose: forward running stride, torso leaned toward right, one leading foot near ground, coat trailing left

frames.label: 충돌
frames.pose: firm forward interception pose, braced front leg, tool or forearm raised to meet an incoming strike from the right

frames.label: 충돌 패배
frames.pose: stagger backward toward left, torso recoiling, bent knees, equipment retained, pained but alive

frames.label: 충돌 승리
frames.pose: confident forward follow-through, stable stance, tool or fist directed right, not a victory dance

frames.label: 피격
frames.pose: distinct hit reaction: chest recoils, face winces, arms instinctively protect abdomen, no wounds or gore

frames.label: 이루어질 · 회피
frames.pose: low lateral dodge, bent knees, torso pulled backward, preserve balance
